subject.title: Model configuration accepts unvalidated model names, enabling silent misconfiguration

question: Should unknown configured model refs be warning-only in doctor/config validate, hard validation errors, or left to runtime/startup handling when catalog authority is incomplete?
rationale: The code can enumerate the refs, but the desired behavior affects custom providers, forward-compatible model names, fail-closed validation, and upgrade safety.

options.title: Warning-first validation
options.body: Add catalog-backed doctor/config warnings for unknown configured refs, with clear wording for custom or untrusted catalogs and no hard failure by default.

options.title: Strict validation
options.body: Reject unknown configured refs at config validation time, accepting a compatibility break unless an explicit escape contract is added.

options.title: Runtime-only handling
options.body: Keep config validation permissive and rely on startup warmup, runtime errors, and fallback notices.

recommendation.title: Warning-first validation
recommendation.body: Add catalog-backed doctor/config warnings for unknown configured refs, with clear wording for custom or untrusted catalogs and no hard failure by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current git-history signal across the validator, configured-ref collector, and doctor check.
